Titel: Interim Head of Accounting – Carve-out (m/f/d)
Unternehmen: Auenfeld Pharma GmbH
Ort: Frankfurt am Main, Hesse, Germany
Quelle: LinkedIn
Link: https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/4187300112/
Abgerufen am: 24.09.2026 07:30

About the job
Auenfeld Pharma is being carved out of its parent group and will operate as a stand-alone company from 1 April 2027. To get there we need an Interim Head of Accounting who has done this before.

You will set up the accounting function of the new entity from scratch: opening balance sheet, chart of accounts, closing calendar, intercompany agreements with the former parent and the transitional service agreements (TSAs) for finance. You will prepare the first stand-alone financial statements under HGB and the reporting package under IFRS for the new owner, a private equity fund, and you will lead a team of four accountants, two of whom are joining during the project.

We expect a proven carve-out track record on the finance side, solid knowledge of German GAAP (HGB) and IFRS, and experience in a PE-backed environment with monthly lender reporting. You know SAP S/4HANA from a user perspective and have worked through at least one ERP cut-over. Fluent German is a must because the team and the auditors work in German; the investor reporting is in English.

The engagement starts on 1 November 2026 and runs for at least nine months. We work remote-first, but we expect you on-site in Frankfurt during closing weeks and for the cut-over weekend. Budget: up to EUR 1,300 per day, all-in (travel expenses included). Interested? Apply via LinkedIn or send us your CV and availability.
